part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `reorderChildren` in `src/diff/children.js:332`: the recursive call's return value — the advanced `oldDom` cursor — was discarded, so after diffing children of a memoized component that bailed out via `shouldComponentUpdate`, the parent kept a stale DOM cursor and subsequent `placeChild`/reorder logic mis-positioned siblings (producing the shuffled `C D A B` order).

The fix (matching upstream preactjs/preact#2896) propagates the returned `oldDom` from the recursive call:

```js
oldDom = reorderChildren(vnode, oldDom, parentDom);
```
